name: Ashraf Ali Ibrahim
original_name: アシュラフ・アリー・イブラーヒーム
source:
Kia's target.

Ashraf is Arabian royalty. He has come to Germany on his European visit. He is third in line to inherit the throne, so many people have attempted to assassinate him or ruin him.
